subject: Binomial count bug fixed in pre-release 3.1.4

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Binomial count bug fixed in pre-release 3.1.4
parts: Versions 3.0.1 to 3.1.3 contained a bug that caused secr.fit to fail or produce bad estimates with binomial count data derived by collapsing binary data from multiple occasions -- including with reduce(..., by = 'all', output = 'count'). When secr.fit is called with count data and binomN = 1 the usage at each detector is treated as the 'size' of a binomial probability (the maximum possible number of observations of an animal). However, the C code for this part of the likelihood was corrupted in secr 3.0.1 (May 2017). The problem is fixed in secr 3.1.4, available on the Density website in pre-release form. Thanks to Mathias Tobler for reporting the issue.
